def solve(req):
    ebits = req['ebits']
    fbits = req['fbits']
    mode = req['mode']
    pairs = req['pairs']

    bias = (1 << (ebits - 1)) - 1
    F = 1 << fbits                # 2**fbits
    Eall = (1 << ebits) - 1       # all-ones exponent
    emin = 1 - bias
    emax = Eall - 1 - bias
    fmask = F - 1
    spos = ebits + fbits          # index of sign bit
    topf = F >> 1                 # top fraction bit (quiet bit)

    CANON_NAN = (Eall << fbits) | topf
    MAX_FIN = ((Eall - 1) << fbits) | fmask

    invalid = False
    any_nan = False
    inf_pos = False               # a positive infinite product exists
    inf_neg = False               # a negative infinite product exists

    prods = []                    # nonzero finite products: (sign, mantissa, exp2)
    any_product = False           # at least one finite (non-NaN, non-inf) pair
    all_neg_zero = True           # every product so far is a negative signed zero

        va = int(pair[0], 16)
        vb = int(pair[1], 16)

import json

def solve(req):
    ebits = req['ebits']
    fbits = req['fbits']
    mode = req['mode']
    pairs = req['pairs']

    bias = (1 << (ebits - 1)) - 1
    F = 1 << fbits                # 2**fbits
    Eall = (1 << ebits) - 1       # all-ones exponent
    emin = 1 - bias
    emax = Eall - 1 - bias
    fmask = F - 1
    spos = ebits + fbits          # index of sign bit
    topf = F >> 1                 # top fraction bit (quiet bit)

    CANON_NAN = (Eall << fbits) | topf
    MAX_FIN = ((Eall - 1) << fbits) | fmask

    invalid = False
    any_nan = False
    inf_pos = False               # a positive infinite product exists
    inf_neg = False               # a negative infinite product exists

    prods = []                    # nonzero finite products: (sign, mantissa, exp2)
    any_product = False           # at least one finite (non-NaN, non-inf) pair
    all_neg_zero = True           # every product so far is a negative signed zero
